wiki.title: Charles Meier
wiki.extract: Charles "Charlie" Meier is a member of the Illinois House of Representatives as a representative for the 109th district. This district includes parts of Bond, Clinton, Madison, St. Clair, and Washington counties in Southern Illinois.
